title: What will Donald Trump say during Midterm Rally in Sioux City, Iowa originally scheduled for October 22, 2026? Healthcare
rules:
If 
 Donald Trump says Healthcare as part of Midterm Rally in Sioux City, Iowa originally scheduled for October 22, 2026
, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Video of the Midterm Rally in Sioux City, Iowa originally scheduled for October 22, 2026 using the live broadcast or stream.
If a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, internal & external (official) transcripts of the Midterm Rally in Sioux City, Iowa originally scheduled for October 22, 2026 will be used.

Payout Criteria
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word. 
Plural nouns occurring within proper nouns and noun phrases (e.g. names, titles, etc).
Donald Trump speaking in an official capacity.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.

Doesn't count for payout
Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. 
Presence alone during a livestream is not sufficient for the market to qualify (e.g., inaudible private conversations on camera, unofficial statements picked up on a hot mic).
Except as otherwise specified, previously aired content, archival footage, and recordings captured at times, places, or events wholly separate from the featured address.

Payout for cancellations and delays
If an event is definitively cancelled or the event fails to qualify under the Payout Criterion, or any other circumstance prevents normal resolution, then the market for "Event does not qualify" resolves to Yes and all other markets will resolve to No.  
If the event is postponed, and such a postponement is announced by the end of the following calendar day to be rescheduled to a time within 14 calendar days, the markets shall remain open.

blind.reasoning: The Sioux City rally was set for Oct 22 with C-SPAN coverage, and healthcare is a top midterm issue: Trump is actively promoting his $500 ACA and $90 Medicare checks, and Democrats are attacking Republicans on it in Iowa. Over a rally of an hour or more, Trump very likely says 'healthcare' at least once, for example when bragging about the checks or attacking Obamacare. The main risks are a speech focused narrowly on immigration or a cancellation.
blind.falsifier: A full transcript or video of the Sioux City speech shows Trump never said 'healthcare'/'health care' (e.g., he discussed only 'checks' or 'Obamacare'), or the rally was cancelled.

final.reasoning: The market at 0.885 essentially agrees with my independent estimate of 0.87, which rests on healthcare checks being a major Trump midterm talking point. The gap is too small to justify a trade given the spread and my uncertainty about whether he says the word itself.
